en: A monochrome illustrated postcard depicting a historic European square bordered by ornate multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows. In the foreground stands a tall Baroque column or monument in the square. At the back of the scene a hill rises with a prominent clock tower on top. The handwritten caption along the lower margin reads in German. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century view card.
